newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul 3-yr bond yields end up, institutions buy.
newsitem.headline: Seoul 3-yr bond yields end up, institutions buy.

text.p: Benchmark three-year corporate bond yields closed lower on Tuesday on strong institutional buying, dealers said.
But three-month CD yields closed higher in line with rising overnight call rate, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.92 pct vs Monday's 11.98
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.00 pct vs Monday's 11.95
* Average overnight call at 11.98 pct vs Monday's 11.90
Dealers said banks reduced CD issues as the short-term liquidity was relatively tight.
The overnight call rate rose on high short-term cash demand, especially from securities firms and merchant banks.
